8395727: TrustStoreManager keeps stale trusted certificates after the key store is reloaded

TrustAnchorManager.getKeyStore() updates the cached descriptor and key
store but leaves the cached trusted certificates untouched. A following
getTrustedCerts() call sees a matching descriptor and returns the
certificates from before the trust store was modified.
